subject: iALS status: Table 5 reproduced, one methodology risk on repetitions
body:
Dmitri, Deshawn,

Status. MovieLens 1M reproduces cleanly with the published settings (embedding_dim 192, 12 epochs, regularization 0.007, unobserved_weight 0.3) - HR@10 and NDCG@10 land within 0.003 of the Table 5 numbers. Pinterest matches too with its own config (16 epochs, regularization 0.02, unobserved_weight 0.007). The py2.7 container worked, so no porting detour needed - good call Oyin.

The methodology risk: published numbers are means over 10 repetitions, and run-to-run variance on Pinterest is big enough that a single lucky run can look +0.004 over the mean. If Evalline consumes a single-seed baseline, teams will 'beat' it with noise. Linnea's proposal, which I support: the packaged baseline ships as a 10-seed protocol with mean and standard deviation, and Evalline gates on the mean minus one sigma.

Remaining: holdout-generation tooling for hyperparameter tuning, then packaging. On track for April 27.

Bilal
